Class Smugglers

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.galaxytruckerproject.model.cards.Card
it.polimi.ingsw.galaxytruckerproject.model.cards.Enemies
it.polimi.ingsw.galaxytruckerproject.model.cards.Smugglers
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class Smugglers extends Enemies
Represents the "Smugglers" enemy card. If a player defeats the smugglers, they receive a set of goods as a reward. If they fail, they must lose a certain number of goods.
